title: Metric Spaces: Definitions and Examples
summary: This document introduces the fundamental theory of metric spaces, covering formal definitions, distance functions, and various examples including Euclidean space and sequence spaces. title: Continuity II: Correspondences in Optimization Theory

title: Linear Spaces

title: Preference and Choice

title: Classical Demand Theory

title: Aggregate Demand

title: Production Theory: Production Sets and Technologies
summary: This document introduces the economic theory of the firm, focusing on production sets, transformation functions, and technological feasibility. title: Simultaneous-Move Games

title: Market Power and Monopoly Pricing

title: Adverse Selection, Signaling, and Screening

title: General Equilibrium Theory: Pure Exchange and the Edgeworth Box

title: Microeconomic Theory: Equilibrium and Welfare Properties

title: Some Foundations for Competitive Equilibria

title: General Equilibrium Under Uncertainty
